suggestions.quote: And Seoul lets them teach only until ten at night. Inspectors have patrolled the streets to make sure (c03).

keep.quote: And here's what you had backwards. You treated the four per cent like four places in a room. But in most subjects, it's the top 4 per cent of everyone in the country who sat it (c01). Four seats, a hundred backs, six weeks of war. For a seat that was never in the room.

Minus never proved they wanted you to fail. It only proved your win hurt. In one brain-scan study, envying a peer who did better at something that mattered came with activity in a region also active in pain (c05).
It's true. In November 2025, during the English listening test, South Korea stopped its planes taking off and landing for 35 minutes, so their noise wouldn't disturb the students (c02).
